ARNB.name: Alien Registration Number
ARNB.definition: Number assigned by a government agency to identify foreign nationals.

ARQC.name: ARQC Verification
ARQC.definition: Verification of a cryptogram generated by a chip card, for instance an ARQC (Authorisation Request Cryptogram).

BTHD.name: Birth Date
BTHD.definition: Date of birth of a person.

CHSA.name: Cardholder Address
CHSA.definition: Verification whether the address corresponds to the cardholder's one.

CUID.name: Customer Identification
CUID.definition: Customer number used as a mechanism of authentication.

DRVI.name: Driver Identification
DRVI.definition: Identification of a driver in a fleet of vehicles.

DRLN.name: Driver License Number
DRLN.definition: Number assigned by a driving license authority to a person driving a car.

EMIN.name: Employee Identification Number
EMIN.definition: Number assigned to an employee by an employer.

EMRN.name: Employer Identification Number
EMRN.definition: Number assigned to an employer by a registration authority.

IDCN.name: Identity Card Number
IDCN.definition: Number assigned by a national authority to an identity card.

MANU.name: Manual Verification
MANU.definition: Manual verification, for example passport or drivers license.

FBIG.name: Off Line Biographics
FBIG.definition: Biographics authentication in an offline mode.

FBIO.name: Off Line Biometrics
FBIO.definition: Biometrics authentication in an offline mode

OLDA.name: Off Line Data Authentication
OLDA.definition: Authentication of data in an offline mode

OFPE.name: Off Line PIN Encrypted
OFPE.definition: PIN generated offline and transmitted encrypted

FCPN.name: Off Line PIN In Clear
FCPN.definition: PIN generated offline and transmitted in clear

OTPW.name: One Time Password
OTPW.definition: Verification of a one-time password provided by the issuer.

NBIG.name: On Line Biographics
NBIG.definition: Biographics authentication in an online mode.

OCHI.name: Other Cardholder Identification
OCHI.definition: Other cardholder data provided for identification.

PSVE.name: Passive Authentication
PSVE.definition: Authentication based on statistical cardholder behaviour.

PASN.name: Passport Number
PASN.definition: Number assigned by a passport authority to a passport.

TOKP.name: Payment Token
TOKP.definition: Verification or authentication related to the use of a payment token, for instance the validation of the authorised use of a token.

PKIS.name: PKI Signature
PKIS.definition: PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) based digital signature

PLOB.name: Place Of Birth
PLOB.definition: Place of birth of a person.

PCDV.name: Postal Code
PCDV.definition: Verification based on digits of the postal code.

SCRT.name: Secure Certificate
SCRT.definition: Electronic commerce transaction secured with the X.509 certificate of a customer.

CSEC.name: Secure Electronic Commerce
CSEC.definition: Authentication performed during a secure electronic commerce transaction.

SSNB.name: Social Security Number
SSNB.definition: Number assigned by a social security agency.

TXIN.name: Tax Identification Number
TXIN.definition: Number assigned by a tax authority to an entity.

TOKA.name: Authentication Token
TOKA.definition: A token is used to verify an already performed authentication.

CDHI.name: Cardholder Identification Data
CDHI.definition: Cardholder data provided for verification, for instance social security number, driver license number, passport number.

TOKN.name: Token Authentication
TOKN.definition: Cryptogram generated by the token requestor or a customer device to validate the authorised use of a token.

THDS.name: Three DS
THDS.definition: Authentication performed during a secure electronic commerce transaction.

CRYP.name: Cryptogram Verification
CRYP.definition: Verification of a cryptogram generated by a chip card or another device, for instance ARQC (Authorisation Request Cryptogram).

ACSN.name: Acceptor Certificate Serial Number
ACSN.definition: Serial number of the acceptor's certificate.

CHSN.name: Cardholder Certificate Serial Number
CHSN.definition: Serial number of the cardholder's certificate.

OTHC.name: Other Cryptogram
OTHC.definition: Verification of a cryptogram generated by a non-card form factor.
